create_grammar_manager: create a GrammarManager instance from a Scheduler to handle constrained grammar-based text generation
process_req_with_grammar: process a request with json_schema, regex, ebnf, or structural_tag grammar constraints and queue it for compilation
get_ready_grammar_requests: get grammar requests that are ready or timed out from the grammar queue across distributed ranks
abort_grammar_requests: abort grammar queue requests matching a request id or all requests in the grammar queue
clear_grammar_backend: clear and reset the grammar backend cache used for grammar compilation
